# Why the Sky Is Blue

The blue color of the sky results from a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, which occurs when sunlight interacts with the gases that make up Earth's atmosphere.

## Sunlight and Wavelengths

Although sunlight appears white, it is actually composed of all the colors of the visible spectrum, each corresponding to a different wavelength. Blue and violet light have short, energetic wavelengths (roughly 380–450 nanometers), while red and orange light have much longer wavelengths (around 620–750 nanometers).
